text:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt for release v2026.03.12 failed security gate: SBOM license mismatch + vuln scan STOP.
alex: saw the deploy-bot alert, can someone paste the SBOM snippet?
julie: adding logs — from sbom-scanner: "license: GPL-3.0-only" on component 'fastxml-legacy' (transitive)
kevin: also vuln scan shows `CVE-2025-9999` in transitive `crypto-foo` -> severity: critical. failing threshold.
alex: that's enough to hold. what's the change window? we're in a weekday small-window until 18:00 PT.
ops-oncall: agreed hold; don't roll forward. can we pin to a non-GPL fork or remove the dep?
julie: quick triage: the vuln is in a transitive build-tool used at build time only. but license is present in final sbom due to packaging. legal might allow with notice.
kevin: legal might be OK, but infra policy requires critical CVE remediated or a signed risk acceptance. we don't have that.
security-bot: @channel risk-level elevated: Blocker - policy 'release:security-v1' triggered. Required: SA approval OR 0-day patch or rollback.
alex: propose two paths: (A) revert to previous image digest (sha256:abcdef...) and re-run canary; (B) emergency patch: bump transitive to patched crypto-foo@2.1.1 and rebuild.
julie: rebuild will take ~40m and needs a patch PR + rebuild + sbom regen + scans. option A is faster.
ops-oncall: if we rollback, ensure release notes mention 'rollback due to security gate' and create a follow-up ticket to land the patch. I'll prep the rollback deploy.
kevin: annotate the release in Jira: RLSE-1987 and tag security-review. set canary to off for this pipeline.
alex: @julie can you open the PR to pin base image digest and add the patched dependency? if not, roll back.
julie: opening PR now, but not confident we can get legal SA in time. I'll also prepare rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for v2026.03.12 -> initiating job 4021. Canary halted. :red_circle:
ops-oncall: monitoring rollback logs. ping me if any surprises.
kevin: postmortem note: improve SBOM exclusion rules to avoid build-only tool licenses leaking. also tighten transitive CVE alerts for release gates.
alex: filing a post-deploy action item. tagging @legal and @security for next steps. :thumbsup: 
julie: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1245 - includes pinned digest + bumped crypto-foo. running CI.
security-bot: CI scan queued. hold remains until green and SA signoff.
ops-oncall: rollback completed, old image sha rolled in, traffic back to 100% on stable. closing release window.
alex: OK — we won't merge the release branch until security signoff. thanks all.
